default/32552.htm.text: Soldier Tomaris: Hmm. Well, it doesn't seem like there's any problem. Are you an adventuer? I heard a number of adventurers have come to Gracia from Aden to help Admiral Keucereus. I guess you're one of them, huh? Thanks for giving us a breather.
